family_pilot__Z_00000_0.part_family: thin-walled molded tray with a grid of circular wells
family_pilot__Z_00000_0.desc: A shallow rectangular molded pocket tray: a flat deck carries a five-by-four grid of twenty round wells with small lip fillets, enclosed by a continuous raised perimeter rim. Four through-holes sit on a large bolt circle, with additional small through-holes on a secondary circle; the underside is a thin shell broken by short integral stiffening ribs/feet and generous edge rounds.

family_pilot__Z_00000_2.part_family: thin-walled molded tray with a grid of circular wells
family_pilot__Z_00000_2.desc: A low-profile carrier plate variant: near-square border with an internal four-by-four array of counterbored blind pockets, every pocket centered on a raised locating boss and tied together by thin molded ribs. Two elongated handling slots pierce one edge, four reinforced holes at the corners share a single bolt circle, and the flat back uses snap-on feet instead of molded ribs.

family_pilot__Z_00001_2.desc: Rectangular low-profile vent cover in the same protective-grille family, using an oval outer rim, two opposed mounting ears, transverse louver bars over a central opening, and small locator bosses on the back face rather than a concentric-ring pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00002_1.part_family: flat radial spider hub with end socket cups
family_pilot__Z_00002_1.desc: Cross-shaped flat hub with a central through-bored boss and four radial arms at right angles, each arm ending in a closed circular counterbored pad instead of an open cup. Small triangular gusset ribs reinforce the arm roots, the edge is a uniform plate thickness, and only the outer corners are filleted.

family_pilot__Z_00002_2.part_family: flat radial spider hub with end socket cups
family_pilot__Z_00002_2.desc: Two-arm bar coupler of the same family: an elongated thin web with a central collar and through hole, carrying one raised square recessed socket at each opposite end. Shallow lightening slots pierce each arm web, there are no ribs on the cup walls, and the few sharp edges are eased with minimal rounds.

family_pilot__Z_00006_2.part_family: thin tri-lobed flat mounting flange plate
family_pilot__Z_00006_2.desc: An elongated two-pad link plate in which two circular end bosses are joined by a tapered web pierced by a long central lightening slot. Each end boss holds one large bore flanked by a pair of small holes on its own bolt circle, and a shallow stiffening bead runs along one edge of the web.

family_pilot__Z_00013_0.desc: Thin rectangular moulded tray built from a flat base panel with an integral low perimeter rim and generously rounded outer corners; one short edge carries a small relieved tab-and-slot detail. The interior field holds a four-by-five array of twenty identical square pockets with filleted corners, separated by uniform thin webs and leaving a blank margin along one side for handling.

family_pilot__Z_00013_2.desc: Deeper open-cassette variant of the same carrier family: a rectangular shell with tall continuous side walls and a reinforced rim, its floor broken by a coarse three-by-four pattern of large rectangular windows with lead-in chamfers. Integral pads and transverse crush ribs on the underside, external stacking lugs on the long walls, and a latch recess at one end let several trays nest and lock.

family_pilot__Z_00016_0.desc: A single straight constant-cross-section toothed bar: a slender solid rail with dense fine teeth running lengthwise on the working faces, rounded roots, tips and edge fillets, and one clean axial through bore; the ends are plain square cuts with no separate joints, bosses, or side branches.

family_pilot__Z_00016_1.desc: A curved rack segment of the same family, with teeth only on the inner arc, a smooth outer back, two integral end lugs with slotted mounting holes, and a relieved central web instead of a through bore; tooth engagement blends into plain runout pads at both ends.

family_pilot__Z_00016_2.desc: A wider multi-track spline strip formed as one extrusion: parallel toothed tracks are separated by shallow guide grooves, one edge carries an integral locating rib, the opposite edge has small clearance slots and cross holes, and both ends are counterbored for pins; fillets are fuller on loaded flanks and smaller on non-contact edges.

family_pilot__Z_00022_2.desc: A thin rounded-pentagon spacer plate built as one flat shell with a fully filleted outer edge, a single large central bore, and five equally spaced perimeter holes set just inboard of the edge. One side includes a narrow radial keyway slot and the bottom face has a shallow recessed pocket around the central bore.

family_pilot__Z_00025_0.desc: A thin-walled injection-molded clip formed as one long flat spine with a regular row of transverse stiffening ribs and low edge walls. Toward one end the spine kinks into an oblique head that carries a recessed circular boss with a coaxial bore, several small through-holes, and short upstanding latch tabs; rib roots and outer edges use small uniform fillets.

family_pilot__Z_00025_2.desc: A short, broad thin-wall molded retainer on a rectangular base whose underside is pocketed by a grid of ribs. Two raised circular standoffs with through bores sit between lightening slots, while one long edge forms a fixed hooked lip and the opposite edge forms a flexible cantilever snap, with generously filleted outer corners.

family_pilot__Z_00026_1.part_family: thin moulded rectangular display bezel frame
family_pilot__Z_00026_1.desc: A deeper rectangular bezel whose ring is split into two stepped levels: a narrow outer ledge for adhesive and a recessed inner shelf that supports a glass panel. Four moulded snap hooks project from the back of the long sides, screw bosses stand at the corners, and a continuous sealing groove runs just inside the outer edge; the front face is chamfered only on the outer rim and the internal corners are generously filleted.

family_pilot__Z_00026_2.part_family: thin moulded rectangular display bezel frame
family_pilot__Z_00026_2.desc: An open C-shaped retaining frame rather than a closed ring: three sides form a thin capturing lip while the fourth side is left open for sliding a panel in. The closed corner is reinforced by a gusset rib and two threaded inserts, the opposite long side has a row of evenly spaced ventilation slots plus a pair of flexible latch fingers, and every exposed edge uses one small uniform chamfer with no corner radii.

family_pilot__Z_00032_0.desc: A uniform-thickness flat metal strap formed into an L-shaped corner brace: a short top leg and a longer drop leg joined by a large outer radius, with an integral diagonal tie between the legs that frames a triangular lightening window. The strip has a narrow rectangular cross-section, all outer corners are rounded with small fillets, and there are several small through holes at the free ends of both legs and along the vertical leg, plus a pair of slightly larger holes clustered at the inner corner.

family_pilot__Z_00033_0.desc: A single flat metal strip of constant thin rectangular cross-section, bent along its length into one smooth, large-radius bow that rises from a rounded tongue end and curls down into a hook-like free end. The strip has uniform width with no holes or cutouts; the curve is continuous with generous bend radii and no sharp folds, forming a simple leaf-spring shape.

family_pilot__Z_00033_1.desc: A flat spring strap bent into an S-curve with two opposing arcs, a punched round mounting hole at each end, and one end rolled into a closed eye. The strip keeps a constant rectangular section through the bends, with a slight narrowing waist at the mid-curve and small chamfers on the edges.

family_pilot__Z_00037_0.part_family: thin flat ported flange / gasket plate
family_pilot__Z_00037_0.desc: A single uniform-thickness flat plate whose outer silhouette is a symmetric three-lobed peanut: a large central round lobe is tangent-blended to two smaller end lobes with concave waists. It carries one large central through-bore and two equal smaller through-holes centered in the end lobes on a common axis. Faces are plain with no ribs, pads, counterbores or slots; external transitions are filleted and each hole keeps a continuous surrounding land.

family_pilot__Z_00037_1.part_family: thin flat ported flange / gasket plate
family_pilot__Z_00037_1.desc: An elongated rounded-rectangular flat flange with one central oval port and four equal through bolt-holes set toward the corners. Two opposed short key slots break the long edges, one face has a shallow counterbore around the port, and a small raised locating boss sits off the main bore while all outer corners are generously radiused.

family_pilot__Z_00039_1.desc: A longer thin-wall tube closed at one end by an integral cap, with three equally spaced radial through-ports around the mid-length and two opposed wrench flats milled on the outside. The open rim gets an external chamfer while the closed end carries an internal counterbore shoulder.

family_pilot__Z_00050_2.desc: A flat anchor plate of constant thickness built from a broad roughly rectangular body with one projecting ear on the longer side. The body carries a central obround slot and a rectangular cluster of four small mounting holes, the ear carries a single large through bore, one corner holds a small locating notch, and the outer edges mix small chamfers and rounded corners while remaining one flat lamina.

family_pilot__Z_00053_1.desc: Stepped female-female hex standoff with a larger hex flange at one end and a smaller hex body extending from it. The bore is threaded at both ends with an unthreaded middle section, plus a single identification groove around the flange and chamfered entry faces.

family_pilot__Z_00057_0.desc: Single folded metal strip forming a long straight face panel with very narrow turned-over longitudinal edge flanges; both short ends are bent upward into ear-like tabs, with small bend radii, visible fold/hem lines, and no through-holes or bosses.

family_pilot__Z_00057_1.desc: Open right-angle sheet-metal bracket with unequal legs: the taller leg carries two round mounting holes while the base leg has one obround slot; one end is stiffened by a small folded triangular gusset and the other end is plain sheared.

family_pilot__Z_00067_1.desc: Bent sheet-metal mounting clip formed into a U-channel from one blank, with two parallel side legs joined by a flat base web. The base carries two clearance holes for fasteners, each leg has one elongated adjustment slot, and a small formed dimple near one end acts as a detent; edges are sheared with modest bend radii at the two folds.

family_pilot__Z_00072_0.desc: Elongated metal block with an inverted-channel cross section: a thick top deck ties two downward side legs and leaves a continuous open cavity beneath. The deck carries a dense regular grid of small through holes in repeated rows, broken by a central rectangular polarizing slot and by scattered depth-limited or counterbored holes; two small groups of holes sit on circular bolt patterns, the end faces add a transverse slot and extra through holes, and a thin upright flange portion is relieved with stacked rectangular windows and stepped edges. Corners are filleted inside and lightly chamfered outside.

family_pilot__Z_00075_0.part_family: open split retaining ring (C-clip) of uniform section
family_pilot__Z_00075_0.desc: A single C-shaped open ring formed from constant square-section metal strip, with smooth concentric inner and outer cylindrical faces and equal axial thickness. The loop closes most of a circle and stops at a bottom gap; both free ends are cut on an angle to make small chamfered tip faces, and there are no holes, ribs, or bosses beyond the central through opening.

family_pilot__Z_00075_1.part_family: open split retaining ring (C-clip) of uniform section
family_pilot__Z_00075_1.desc: A flat stamped external snap ring: a thin constant-thickness annular C-plate whose radial width is much greater than its axial thickness. The gap is flanked by two opposed lug ears, each pierced with one round plier hole, with a small locating notch on the inner edge and gently rounded, deburred end corners.

family_pilot__Z_00082_0.desc: Thin uniform sheet plate whose solid central hub is integrally joined to six identical narrow arms set in a regular hexagonal radial pattern; each arm ends in a raised circular eye boss carrying a through-hole with a countersunk seat on one face, all six holes sharing a common bolt circle with filleted arm-to-boss transitions and an open lattice between arms.

family_pilot__Z_00088_0.desc: One slender uniform-thickness sheet-metal strip with a straight rectangular web and a short continuous lip folded along one long edge, giving a narrow open angle section. It has two small through holes near opposite ends and a small rounded corner at one tip, with no slots, ribs, bosses, or repeated pattern.

family_pilot__Z_00088_1.desc: A wider same-family retainer formed as a shallow channel: a flat center web with both long edges turned into short parallel flanges. It carries three round mounting holes along the web and a pair of elongated slots toward one end, with plain square ends and small corner fillets.

family_pilot__Z_00088_2.desc: A compact offset spring-clip strip bent into a stepped profile with two opposed flanges joined by a narrow web and a curled latch tab at one end. It mixes one obround adjustment slot, two punched holes on the opposite flange, and a single small dimple, leaving the edges otherwise plain.

family_pilot__Z_00089_0.desc: Rectangular open lattice assembled from thin flat metal strip: several upright stiles are tied by many evenly spaced horizontal rungs into adjacent ladder bays across a squat oblong outline. Short mounting feet sit on the top edge, a column of small rectangular standoff tabs projects from one side edge at a few heights for clipping to a rail or a mating panel, and a shallow bent foot at the base forms a standoff; crossings are spot-joined with essentially square edges and no modelled fillets.

family_pilot__Z_00089_1.desc: Tall single-bay version of the same strip grille: two full-length side rails bridged by one regular row of horizontal rungs, with a formed mounting flange along the bottom edge and a pair of slotted hanging hooks at the top. Small pressed dimples between rungs stiffen mid-span, and there are no side standoff tabs.

family_pilot__Z_00101_2.desc: A chainring-style toothed plate with a six-arm web carrying alternating rounded-triangular windows and round holes; the center is a splined through bore instead of a plain hole, and the outer teeth are relieved on one side to give a single-sided tooth profile.

family_pilot__Z_00103_0.part_family: thin flat sheet-metal strip with bevelled ends
family_pilot__Z_00103_0.desc: A single uniform-gauge flat plate whose plan outline is an elongated parallelogram: two long parallel straight edges with both short ends cut on complementary angles so the two opposing corners form reversed arrow/chisel points. It is an unformed blank (dead flat,矩形 side profile) with no holes, slots, bends, ribs or bosses; edges are plain sheared with a minimal break.

family_pilot__Z_00103_1.part_family: thin flat sheet-metal strip with bevelled ends
family_pilot__Z_00103_1.desc: A symmetrical flat tie/gusset blank of the same thin gauge, shaped as a long double-ended arrow: centre rectangular waist flanked by mirrored bevelled tips at both ends. It carries a centred longitudinal slot and two round mounting holes toward each end, all edges lightly chamfered, and remains completely flat with no formed features.

family_pilot__Z_00111_1.desc: A thin rectangular sheet-metal bezel with a continuous raised outer rim and a honeycomb rib lattice spanning a single wide window. The rim carries six clearance holes on one bolt circle, two oblong tool slots, and a pair of folded side flanges for stiffness, with small round fillets wherever the ribs meet the rim.

family_pilot__Z_00115_2.part_family: small toothed transmission elements - annular ring gears, pinions and straight racks
family_pilot__Z_00115_2.desc: Flanged internal ring gear: a thicker annular shell with teeth machined on the inner bore and a smooth ground outer pilot diameter, one end face stepped into a bolt flange carrying a circle of counterbored holes with lightening pockets between them, a recessed hub with a retaining-ring groove and a single radial dowel hole, and a filleted transition from rim to hub.

family_scale1__Z_00009_1.part_family: thin flat mounting plate with raised damper-cradle corner bosses
family_scale1__Z_00009_1.desc: A circular three-lobe isolator plate: one solid dished web carries three raised pads evenly spaced on the rim, each pad bored straight through to capture a rubber bobbin and sandwiched by a pair of small fixing holes. The rim is a plain filleted edge broken by a few radial lightening slots, with no central opening.

family_scale1__Z_00009_2.part_family: thin flat mounting plate with raised damper-cradle corner bosses
family_scale1__Z_00009_2.desc: A ladder-style damper carrier built from two parallel raised rails joined by several slim cross ties into an open thin frame. Each rail end terminates in an enclosed cylindrical boss bored end to end rather than an open cradle, the bays between ties form elongated strap slots, the rails are drilled with countersunk holes, and the outer corners are chamfered instead of radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00018_0.part_family: slender fine-toothed cruciform shaft (serrated pin bar)
family_scale1__Z_00018_0.desc: A long straight rod of constant cruciform (plus-shaped) cross-section formed by four longitudinal ribs. The profile mixes four larger outer corner radii with eight smaller re-entrant radii, the flanks are covered by numerous fine rounded serrations (forty-four in all) running the full length like a miniature rack, and one small axial through-hole passes end to end through the web.

family_scale1__Z_00020_2.desc: A single-fold L bracket in thin sheet with one long mounting leg and one short leg. The long leg is pierced by a grille of narrow ventilation slots plus two elongated adjustment slots, the short leg carries four clinch nuts around a central semicircular cable notch, and the fold is reinforced by two small formed triangular gussets with hemmed outer edges.

family_scale1__Z_00025_1.desc: A flat base plate with slotted mounting holes near the corners carries a single tall upright block positioned toward one edge rather than centered. The block has one large through bore for a shaft, threaded ports on both side faces, and a pattern of blind counterbored holes across the top. Two external side ribs replace the central gusset, and the base has lightening pockets between the mounting slots.

family_scale1__Z_00035_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness star plate with a small circular hub and one centered through hole; six radial arrowhead blades are blended into the hub, separated by concave round scallops, with faceted edge bevels terminating in sharp points.

family_scale1__Z_00048_1.desc: A longer panel-edge clip in the same family: the gripping element is a shallow half-round C-channel with a wide mouth that closes over a flange rather than a rod, and the hanging web is broad with one central obround slot plus a single line of small through holes for screws. Instead of a continuous return foot, the bottom ends in two separated outward barbs.

family_scale1__Z_00050_0.desc: Short straight brass-toned profile of constant, roughly square cross-section with plain square-cut ends. A single axial through-hole runs the full length at the centre, while the outer faces carry narrow longitudinal grooves and one side is opened into a channel; outer corners, slot mouths and groove roots are all softened with small rounds, with numerous tiny edge breaks along the length.

family_scale1__Z_00050_2.desc: A half-round guide variant: constant D-shaped section with a flat mounting face containing a wide dovetail slot and a crowned face broken up by several axial flutes. Two small parallel axial bores replace the single central lumen, one bore has a lengthwise keyway, the perimeter uses one generous blend radius with only a few small rounds, and one end is cross-drilled for a locking pin.

family_scale1__Z_00064_1.desc: Four-arm flat cross flange with a ring-shaped central boss; two opposite arms end in slotted adjustment ears while the other pair carry plain circular holes, with pressed ribs along each arm and a countersunk bolt pattern around the bore.

family_scale1__Z_00064_2.desc: Asymmetric radial plate with a compact central body, one long slotted arm, one short single-hole ear, and one forked ear; it uses a large central clearance opening, embossed stiffening beads, and smooth fillets rather than separate pads.

family_scale1__Z_00076_1.desc: A narrow molded-plastic bracket with an elongated base having rounded ears at both ends, each ear holding a single mounting hole. A closed-top rectangular shroud rises from the center of the plate, braced by triangular gussets on four sides and fitted with one large transverse bore plus a pair of small alignment-pin holes; a lone cylindrical standoff with a single radial rib sits on the base ahead of the shroud.

family_scale1__Z_00080_0.part_family: thin plate toothed sprocket / chainring with bolt-circle mounting
family_scale1__Z_00080_0.desc: A flat annular plate of uniform thickness with a large plain central bore that carries a shallow counterbore on one face; a ring of ten small through-holes sits on a bolt circle around the bore. The outer edge is machined into a continuous row of pointed teeth with rounded scalloped roots, and the tooth flanks are chamfered symmetrically on both faces, as shown by a zoomed detail of the tooth profile.

family_scale1__Z_00080_2.part_family: thin plate toothed sprocket / chainring with bolt-circle mounting
family_scale1__Z_00080_2.desc: A rear-wheel drive sprocket formed as a thin annulus with a central recessed hub flange on one side; six round lightening apertures alternate with six threaded mounting bores around a bolt circle, the bore is plain and through, and the outer rim carries closely spaced low-profile teeth with generous root fillets and a one-sided chamfer on the tooth flanks.

family_scale1__Z_00082_0.part_family: Machined roller-chain sprocket with integral hub
family_scale1__Z_00082_0.desc: A single-strand machined chain sprocket whose outer toothed ring is one piece with a flat annular web; the web carries an annular lightening recess, eight equally spaced through-holes on a bolt circle around the axis, and a central plain through-bore. A short stepped hub projects from one face only, while the opposite face is flat, and the tooth gullets are fully radiused with small edge breaks at the rim and bore.

family_scale1__Z_00082_2.part_family: Machined roller-chain sprocket with integral hub
family_scale1__Z_00082_2.desc: A double-row chain sprocket formed as two coaxial toothed rings separated by a relieved central groove, joined to a long stepped hub on one side. The hub contains a through bore with an axial keyway plus a radial set-screw hole, and the web between the tooth rows is opened by six kidney-shaped lightening slots with no mounting bolt circle.

family_scale1__Z_00090_1.desc: A double-row sprocket in which two parallel toothed rings are separated by a central circumferential groove and share one wide mid hub, making the section symmetric about the mid-plane. The central bore is keyed and is crossed by a tapped set-screw hole in the hub, and every tooth is chamfered on both flanks for chain entry; the teeth are fewer and coarser than on a fine instrument sprocket.

family_scale1__Z_00092_2.desc: A lightweight molded idler sprocket has a narrow toothed outer band supported by a handful of curved spokes that converge into a short central hub. The hub contains a press-fit bearing sleeve with an internal retaining-ring groove, while the rim adds a one-face guide flange and a few deliberately skipped teeth within the otherwise regular pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00096_1.part_family: welded multi-bay open truss frame of formed sheet-metal box sections
family_scale1__Z_00096_1.desc: Shorter two-rail equipment skid: two parallel folded-channel side members tied by several evenly spaced straight crossmembers with triangular gusset plates at each joint. A flat punched mounting flange runs along one rail, round tooling holes line the crossmembers, square-cut ends carry welded lifting eyes, and the underside has two bolt-on wear pads rather than ramps.

family_scale1__Z_00096_2.part_family: welded multi-bay open truss frame of formed sheet-metal box sections
family_scale1__Z_00096_2.desc: Closed perimeter tray frame for a battery or electronic rack: a mitred rectangular outer hoop of box section with one central spine and a few transverse ribs dividing the interior into unequal pockets. Ribs hold pressed threaded inserts and countersunk flange holes, small drainage slots pierce the lower chord, corners are radiused instead of chamfered, and a single removable bolt-in crossbar bridges the middle.

family_scale1__Z_00107_0.desc: A single monolithic flat plate of uniform thickness with a central round through-bore and a scalloped eight-lobed outer rim. Six hexagonal through-cutouts sit in one ring on a common pitch circle between the bore and the rim, leaving a honeycomb-like web, while semicircular notches separate adjacent lobes and all lobe roots and edges carry small rounds; there are no ribs or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00107_2.desc: A stamped thin clover-leaf plate with a D-shaped central bore for a shaft keyway and five round lightening holes on a pitch circle. The four-lobed rim has deep concave waists between lobes, one index notch on the perimeter, and a small bent mounting ear formed on two opposite lobes.

family_scale1__Z_00109_0.part_family: closed toothed timing-belt loop with integral hub
family_scale1__Z_00109_0.desc: An endless, elongated stadium-loop synchronous band molded as a thin rectangular-section belt, with uniform transverse drive teeth running along both straight runs and around the two semicircular pulley ends. A short cylindrical collar is integrally joined to one straight run, carrying a central through bore, a round mounting flange and a hexagonal across-flats wrenching top; a few small radiused relieving features sit in the band beside the collar. The band section is a narrow vertical rib that locally swells into the taller hub, formed as one continuous molded part.

family_scale1__Z_00110_0.part_family: freestanding openwork emblem medallion on a pedestal
family_scale1__Z_00110_0.desc: This part is a thin flat decorative medallion: a ribbed outer annulus is tied by sweeping curved spokes to an off-center inner ring, making one large crescent opening and a smaller central eye; the lower spoke necks into a stepped plinth with a flared support, rounded feet, small fillets, and an across-flats boss for attachment.

family_scale1__Z_00113_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate with a three-lobe clover outline; three equal large through-bores are equally spaced on a common bolt circle around one central through-bore of the same size, and the four circular boss rings are tied together by short curved webs. Small oblong lightening slots pierce the webs between adjacent bores, and the whole outer perimeter is a continuous filleted contour with a ring of identical small edge rounds.

family_scale1__Z_00113_2.desc: Asymmetric dogbone link plate of constant thickness with two large coaxial through-bores joined by a narrow pinched waist; one bore is counterbored to form a stepped bearing seat while the other stays straight through. A row of small tooling holes runs along the centerline, one side web has a single long lightening slot, and the outline blends the two end rings with large tangent radii and fully rounded edges.

family_scale1__Z_00116_1.desc: A same-family stamped contact that remains essentially planar: a wide mounting pad with two pierced holes and short stiffening ribs feeds a single cantilevered spring arm ending in a bifurcated fork. The fork uses coined contact dimples, one rectangular inspection window, rolled entry edges, and a carrier edge with pilot slots rather than any right-angle folded leg.

family_scale1__Z_00116_2.desc: A same-family formed receptacle with a closed U crimp barrel at the rear transitioning through a right-angle twist into a boxed female blade socket. The socket is a folded tube with a flared entry mouth, one internal cantilever spring tongue, side lance locks, and several pierced windows, omitting mounting tabs and across-flats in favor of a wire-barrel attachment.

family_scale1__Z_00126_0.part_family: thin molded aperture plate / connector-bezel frame
family_scale1__Z_00126_0.desc: A thin flat rigid plate of uniform thickness with a rounded, stepped outer contour. The main rectangular body is an open frame pierced by two large stacked rectangular through-windows, joined on one side to a smaller raised pod carrying its own rectangular aperture and on the opposite side to an ear holding three in-line through-holes. Window rims have shallow recessed ledges, and all internal and external edges are softened with small edge rounds plus larger corner fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00126_2.part_family: thin molded aperture plate / connector-bezel frame
family_scale1__Z_00126_2.desc: An elongated member of the same family arranged as a multi-port frame: several small rectangular slots in a single row form the front face, backed by a patterned grid of thin ribs between the openings. One side carries two parallel rows of through-holes for pins, the opposite edge is a chamfered lead-in rather than a round, and a central cylindrical locating boss with a datum hole sits on the back surface.

family_scale1__Z_00137_0.desc: A thin flat delta-shaped base plate has rounded corner pads, each pierced by a small mounting through hole, and carries two parallel upright lugs near its middle. Each lug ends in a semicircular eye with a transverse through hole for a pin or shaft, and triangular gussets plus open webbed ribs tie the lugs and central posts back into the plate with filleted junctions for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00137_2.desc: A thicker triangular ribbed base carries three short clevis ears in an inline row rather than paired eyes, each ear formed with an oval cross slot instead of a round pin hole. The back face is stiffened by a dense honeycomb of thin ribs, and the perimeter uses four plain mounting holes with no dedicated corner pads.

family_scale1__Z_00143_0.desc: Thin-wall molded polymer pivot arm built as one tapered open web that widens into a transverse hinge block. The blade carries mixed lightening windows: a small arrow-like slot near the tip, two curved teardrop slots, and a lower triangular opening; the block has two parallel through-bores in raised circular bosses. Edge flanges, short gussets and the boss pads tie the web to the hinge, with small chamfers on rib edges and filleted root blends.

family_scale1__Z_00159_2.desc: End-cap style formed bracket from the same family, made as a closed rectangular strap with an overlapping lock seam and short mounting flanges turned out at both ends. Stiffening ribs run across the flats, two keyhole slots are punched in one face and a single large round port in the opposite face, with curled safe edges and small corner radii throughout rather than footed bends.

family_scale1__Z_00166_0.desc: A thin rectangular base panel carries a raised perimeter rim that forms a shallow open tray, joined as one machined part. Corner pads with through mounting holes sit at the rim, while the interior holds a central rectangular recessed pocket ringed by ribs, a smaller raised rectangular pad inside it, and several cylindrical standoff bosses of differing heights; numerous small through holes, counterbored holes and edge chamfers complete the pattern.

family_scale1__Z_00166_1.desc: An elongated flat carrier plate of the same family uses four outboard mounting ears with slotted holes instead of corner posts. A large central through cutout clears a connector, short radial ribs run from the cutout to a low outer rim, and a pair of tall threaded standoffs plus scattered tie-down holes replace the recessed rectangular pocket.

family_scale1__Z_00171_0.desc: A shallow rectangular electronics enclosure shell with an open top, a flat floor and four low thin walls, joined with small interior corner fillets. Two opposite walls are densely louvered with vertical vent slots, the four interior corners carry cylindrical screw bosses with a mix of through and blind holes, and there are small external mounting ears plus an internal guide rail and recessed floor area.

family_scale1__Z_00171_1.desc: A taller clamshell enclosure cover in the same family, with a uniform perimeter wall, a tongue-and-groove mate edge and snap-latch tabs on the front. Ventilation is shifted to horizontal louvers on the front face and a circular fan grille on the top, while the inside has a grid of PCB standoffs, transverse stiffening ribs and two side cable cutouts.

family_scale1__Z_00184_0.desc: Thin-walled rectangular molded-plastic cover with a solid perimeter frame and several parallel lengthwise ribs separated by open slots, forming a vented face. One short edge has two spaced hinge knuckles sharing a coaxial pin through-hole; the opposite edge carries a small centered latch/pull recess, with chamfered lead-in edges, rounded corners, edge fillets, and shallow drafted side walls.

family_scale1__Z_00193_0.desc: A flat protective grille for an axial fan built from concentric circular hoops welded to radial spokes and a small dished central hub. The outer boundary is a polygonal across-flats band with rounded corner ears, carrying a four-hole mounting pattern on a bolt circle plus additional corner holes; flat strip ribs and thin round cross wires are joined at the intersections with small edge fillets, and the hub has a central stepped/counterbored opening.

family_scale1__Z_00194_0.desc: Bent thin-gauge console shell made as one folded enclosure: a long flat base tray with a short chamfered front lip rises into an inclined control face, steps up with rounded top corners into a taller rear box that has a recessed rectangular window/bezel, and is closed by folded end walls. One connector face is densely patterned with many small round through-holes plus a few larger mounting holes, while internal bend seams form hidden divider bays and carry welded studs/standoff bosses; exposed edges are chamfered and bend corners are generously filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00199_1.desc: Symmetrical rocker shoe with the same obround footprint but a centered crown and both short ends rolled downward. Split the grip into several transverse rib bands separated by smooth relief grooves, mold the underside as a shallow shell with perimeter stiffeners, and add two counterbored mounting holes plus three blind bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00200_2.part_family: ribbed cast metal mounting flange bracket
family_scale1__Z_00200_2.desc: A narrow oblong base joins two bushing bosses at its ends with an arched spine rib. An offset cylindrical post with a cross bore sits mid-span beside an upturned rectangular mounting tab, and lightening pockets plus small filleted gussets break up the otherwise thin shell.

family_scale1__Z_00204_0.desc: A thin machined linkage plate in which a small eye hub at one end feeds a wider flat arm that terminates in a rectangular flange pad, while a narrower second arm rises from the same hub to a slotted crossbar with short blocks. The flange carries one large central through-bore ringed by four equally spaced bolt-circle holes plus a mix of countersunk and plain screw holes, and the arms carry cross-bored barrel bosses, rectangular slots, filleted junctions and a stepped edge thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00204_1.desc: A two-leg bell-crank plate with the pivot bore set at an offset elbow, one long straight leg ending in a slotted clevis and the other in a single flanged bearing boss rather than a bolt-circle pad. A row of threaded holes runs along the straight leg, cored lightening pockets pierce the web, and a raised gusset rib stiffens the outer edge.

family_scale1__Z_00208_1.desc: A flat four-ear flange plate of even thickness with four rounded pads set at right angles around a central boss; the boss has a large through bore with a single keyway slot, each ear has a plain drilled hole with no counterbore, and two small alignment notches are cut into the outer edge.

family_scale1__Z_00208_2.desc: An elongated two-pad link plate of constant thickness: circular end pads are joined by a narrower waisted middle, one pad holds a single large through bore with a shallow spotface while the other has an obround adjustment slot, the whole perimeter is filleted, and a blind lightening pocket is recessed into the waist.

family_scale1__Z_00220_0.desc: A thin uniform plate is formed as three rounded lobes around a central through bore, joined by concave saddle webs that leave three inward cutouts. Each lobe has a large through hole equally spaced on a common bolt circle, and every exposed lobe rim carries a continuous row of small semicircular scallops or castellations.

family_scale1__Z_00220_1.desc: A four-arm member of the same flat spinner-plate family places four bearing holes in a square pattern around a central hub bore, with broader arched spokes between arms. Only the outer crown of each arm has short rectangular grip teeth, and each spoke includes an oval lightening slot.

family_scale1__Z_00224_2.desc: A dished belt wheel of the same family with a deep V-grooved outer rim connected to a hub offset to one side by a thin perforated web pierced by a ring of large round lightening holes. The projecting hub boss carries a keyseated bore and a tapped locking hole, and short reinforcing ribs bridge from the back of the boss into the web.

family_scale1__Z_00225_2.desc: Six-spoke flanged spider: a stepped ring hub with a counterbored through hole and an internal keyway drives six short radial spokes that merge into a continuous thin outer rim. A bolt circle of tapped holes sits in the rim, alternate spokes are pierced by oval lightening slots, one face is locally recessed around the hub, and the spoke-to-rim and spoke-to-hub junctions are fully filleted with chamfered hole mouths.

family_scale1__Z_00229_1.desc: A snap-on cosmetic trim variant in the same bezel family: a low rounded-rectangle loop whose show face is continuous and polished while the rear has one uninterrupted sealing lip plus four resilient snap hooks near the corners and two opposing alignment ribs. The window is shifted toward one end to clear a display, one long side carries a short row of vent slots, and the inner corner is left open as a single generous radius rather than a stepped rail.

family_scale1__Z_00229_2.desc: A gasket-retaining frame variant: a closed rounded-rectangular loop sized for a card or connector opening, with a single continuous O-ring groove on the sealing face instead of multiple beads. The two short edges each hold a moulded alignment pin, one long edge integrates a thin living-hinge flap rib for a dust cover, and the opposite long edge has three screw bosses with through holes and counterbores; exterior corners are heavily filleted and all free edges are broken with small chamfers.

family_scale1__Z_00252_0.desc: A square open lattice plate built from two orthogonal sets of thin intersecting walls that form a four-by-four array of identical square pockets inside a continuous perimeter frame. The ribs are fused at every crossing and rise to one uniform height, with small radii on the four outside corners; the floor of each pocket carries a single centered vertical through-hole for sixteen holes on a regular square pitch.

family_scale1__Z_00253_0.desc: A flat circular moulded bezel built from one continuous outer annular rim with a rounded front edge and a flat rear face. Across the open centre, two gently bowed horizontal louvers bridge the left and right rim to leave a wide eye-shaped middle slot, while the regions above and below are mirror-fanned by short radial spokes into trapezoidal vents; small round through-pads sit at the spoke roots and the inner edges carry repeated small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00268_1.desc: Same family in a different layout: a larger square molded grid tray with a three-by-three array of fully through square cells and no locating bosses, built with a deeper box-style perimeter wall, two opposing hand-grip slots in the rim, double cross-braced ribs on the underside only, and countersunk mounting holes limited to the four corners plus one center point.

family_scale1__Z_00268_2.desc: Compact half-depth variant of the same lattice panel family: a staggered grid of circular apertures instead of square cells, a single thickened longitudinal spine rib, barbed snap-fit clips molded on both short edges, and a sparse field of tiny vent holes; one face is ribbed and filleted while the opposite face is left smooth and flat for a printed label or adhesive pad.

family_scale1__Z_00274_2.part_family: serrated twin-rail fork slide with transverse head block
family_scale1__Z_00274_2.desc: An asymmetric cantilever variant pairs one long fully toothed rail with a shorter smooth rail, both projecting from a common cheek plate rather than a closed block. The cheek plate is built up with two round pin-eye bosses and a keyway slot, a triangular rib braces the longer rail, the rail tips are rounded instead of lipped, and the tooth pattern is a coarser sawtooth confined to a central band rather than running edge to edge.

family_scale1__Z_00285_1.desc: Four-bore variant of the same family: a continuous rounded-square rim carries four equal through-bore bosses around a central splined hub, tied by radial ribs with alternating lightening pockets. Add two small clocking dowel holes and a shallow thrust-face recess on one side.

family_scale1__Z_00285_2.desc: Elongated two-bore carrier link from the same family: stepped bearing bosses at both ends are connected by an arched open web with scalloped edges and rounded fillets. Three auxiliary through holes sit between the main bores, and one mounting ear uses a slot instead of a round hole.

family_scale1__Z_00289_0.desc: Open-topped rectangular thermoplastic housing formed as a flat floor fused to low perimeter walls, with rounded outer corners, edge slots, interior ribs, corner posts, and raised cylindrical bosses. The floor carries a dense connector pattern: three larger through-bores in a line, multiple counterbored or countersunk screw holes, several small through and blind holes in grouped rows, shallow circular recesses, and filleted intersections.

family_scale1__Z_00289_2.desc: Another plausible part is a low-profile terminal-block carrier: a ribbed base plate with short snap-in sidewalls, six circular knockout bosses, two elongated cable slots, a molded label recess, and alternating through-holes and blind mounting bosses. Stiffening ribs would follow the boss grid, with small radii at all wall and boss junctions for molding release.

family_scale1__Z_00300_1.desc: Same family of thin-wall flanged bezels, but split into two side-by-side windows separated by a narrow mullion with a continuous perimeter gasket groove on the rear face. Fastening is by molded snap hooks and four corner studs with threaded inserts instead of a drilled bolt circle, with short transverse ribs tying the mullion to the rim and a plain straight outer flange rather than chamfered hole pads.

family_scale1__Z_00307_2.desc: A spring-link variant with a slim leaf body, one round mounting hole and one elongated adjustment slot near the ends. Instead of a single row, it uses two staggered teardrop cutouts with coined dimples between them and a folded locating tab at one end.

family_scale1__Z_00317_1.desc: Taller fence-like variant that drops the feet and adds a middle horizontal rail, splitting the slats into two stacked bays with a repeating wide-narrow spacing rhythm and an occasional thicker rib in place of a rod. One vertical edge carries a run of hinge barrels while the opposite edge has a latch boss and catch ramp for chaining panels together, and the back face uses a continuous perimeter stiffening rib with blind tooling pads instead of through holes.

family_scale1__Z_00336_2.desc: A fan-shaped corner vent guard with two radial side edges converging to a small nose and a curved outer band. Concentric ribs create graduated teardrop and circular apertures; the outer band has countersunk mounting holes and the backside uses short gusset ribs for stiffness.

family_scale1__Z_00339_2.desc: Asymmetric rectangular-cross plate: four arms in two unequal pairs extend from a shallow pressed center cup, with the main through hole offset from the geometric center. Two opposite arms end in raised threaded standoff bosses on the back face while the other two end in elongated slots; outer corners use relief notches and the sheared edges are left mostly unrounded.

family_scale1__Z_00346_1.desc: A sibling enclosure uses a deeper offset bathtub cavity and a continuous cover flange; one long wall carries a row of rectangular connector windows, the opposite wall has a single round bulkhead bore, and internal standoff ribs split the floor into separate board and battery bays with threaded inserts around the rim.

family_scale1__Z_00348_2.desc: An oval openwork cover whose center band is a coarse hexagonal lattice and whose rim is a solid rolled flange; intermittent edge slots clear adjacent features, and three raised pads on the back face provide fastening points.

family_scale1__Z_00352_0.desc: A uniform-thickness flat plate cut as a five-pointed star, with chamfered outer edges and an inset star outline on the face forming a narrow raised border that follows the perimeter. The points are sharp with small fillets at the re-entrant corners, and there are no holes, slots, bosses, or backside ribs.

family_scale1__Z_00352_1.desc: A six-pointed star badge plate with a slightly raised outer rim, a recessed inner hexagram field, and a single central through-hole for a fastener. The point tips are rounded, the face edges are beveled, and two small alignment bosses sit on the back.

family_scale1__Z_00352_2.desc: A four-point compass-star medallion plate with a central counterbored mounting bore and a decorative beveled face. The backside carries short radial ribs between the points for stiffness, and the re-entrant corners are generously filleted for casting or molding.

family_scale1__Z_00359_1.desc: Flat round grille disc built from a plain outer mounting ring and an inner field of concentric circular slots separated by thin webs. Four evenly spaced countersunk fastener holes pierce the flange, and the face is planar rather than domed, with a light chamfer around the perimeter.

family_scale1__Z_00360_2.desc: A thin stamped sheet-metal cross bracket built from a square center pad with four asymmetric arms; two opposite arms are folded into short flanged ears with slots while the other pair stay flat with pilot holes. Pressed stiffening ribs radiate from the pad, and one arm includes an offset clip tab.

family_scale1__Z_00362_2.part_family: lathe-turned metal spool-standoff with bolted cap head
family_scale1__Z_00362_2.desc: Same family built around a low pancake head with eight tapped holes split across two concentric bolt circles and a central through bore, instead of a single ring of through holes. The body is a straight cylindrical barrel rather than an hourglass, cut with two external snap-ring grooves and one radial cross hole, while the far end is a hexagonal wrenching flange with a short pilot spigot; flange roots use small fillets and the rim gets one generous chamfer.

family_scale1__Z_00377_0.desc: Thin constant-thickness plate with a central circular boss carrying a through bore and a coaxial counterbore for a press bearing. Three waisted arms leave the hub at equal angular spacing and each flares into a raised annular lug pierced by a hexagonal through pocket; every arm-to-hub and arm-to-lug transition is softly filleted, with shallow ring recesses on the faces around the holes.

family_scale1__Z_00378_2.part_family: flanged timing belt pulley with ring of rounded radial teeth
family_scale1__Z_00378_2.desc: A lightweight molded variant in which five curved spokes connect the toothed outer ring to a compact central boss; the ring carries alternating tall and short rounded lugs on its inner diameter, the web is opened with sector lightening pockets, and the bore is D-shaped for positive shaft indexing.

family_scale1__Z_00382_1.desc: A similar round flange has a hub projecting from both faces so the center reads as a short barrel, and its central through bore includes one internal keyseat. The annular web is pierced by four equally spaced clearance holes on a single bolt circle, while the rim gets a small chamfer and one external locating notch.

family_scale1__Z_00404_0.desc: Uniform-thickness flat profiled plate with a small central hub and three identical radial arms spaced equally around the center. Each arm expands into a rounded paddle end with one through hole, and the hub carries a single central through hole, with the three outer holes equally spaced on one bolt circle. All edges are cut in the plane of the sheet: concave necks between arms, convex lobed tips, and no formed bends, ribs, or raised bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00418_2.desc: A two-prong coiled contact pin with a short socket that splits into two parallel spring legs, joined along part of their length by one crimp band; it has opposed seams, rounded tips, and a single radial retention dimple on the socket.

family_scale1__Z_00440_0.part_family: shaft-mounted crank disk with offset pin
family_scale1__Z_00440_0.desc: A thin round metal disk is mounted on a straight through-shaft on its central axis, the shaft projecting from both faces of the disk and ending in a short stepped-down tip; one smaller solid pin is set into the disk parallel to the shaft at a radial offset and projects from one face, while matching plain drilled bores pass through the plate. The disk has uniform thickness with no ribs, pockets or fillets, and all features are cylindrical and either concentric with the shaft axis or parallel to it.

family_scale1__Z_00440_1.part_family: shaft-mounted crank disk with offset pin
family_scale1__Z_00440_1.desc: A single oblong cam plate is keyed onto a short central hub rather than a full round flange; two drive pins of different diameters stand off the same face at unequal radii from the hub, and the hub is split by a radial clamping slot with a perpendicular set-screw hole so the plate can be locked to an axle. The plate edge is a smooth radius-ended outline with one clearance notch.

family_scale1__Z_00441_1.desc: A flat, non-canted rectangular cover of the same constant gauge is dished into a shallow pan by an upturned flange on all four sides, with generous corner radii instead of sharp breaks. It carries four obround mounting slots near the corners, a central pressed emboss on the face, and two long stiffening beads formed across the back.

family_scale1__Z_00442_1.desc: Single-slope machine gib wedge: one long face is a flat inclined plane while the opposite face stays vertical, giving a triangular side profile beneath a short rectangular head. Run one through slot lengthwise for adjustment and put one tapped blind hole in the thick end for a draw bolt, with a lead-in chamfer on the thin toe and small edge breaks elsewhere.

family_scale1__Z_00442_2.desc: Symmetric double-tapered dovetail insert where two opposed flanks are drafted toward a narrow base while the remaining pair of faces stay parallel, wrapped by a shallow mid-height external groove marking a two-piece clamping line. Add two counterbored through holes across the wide top plus a small central lifting boss with a cross hole, generous fillets at the internal step, and ground finish on the working flanks.

family_scale1__Z_00444_0.part_family: T-handle of thin-wall tube and cross pin
family_scale1__Z_00444_0.desc: A T-shaped round-stock assembly: one long straight hollow thin-wall tube is the vertical stem and a short solid cylindrical bar is fixed square across the stem crown to form the grip. The stem is a constant-bore tube open at the lower end, the crossbar carries a small transverse through-hole near one end plus a second through feature, and the two round bodies meet at a small welded/filleted crown joint with no ribs, bosses, slots or patterned features.

family_scale1__Z_00444_1.part_family: T-handle of thin-wall tube and cross pin
family_scale1__Z_00444_1.desc: A solid quick-release style T-pin: a straight round-rod stem is cross-drilled near the lower end for a locking element and pressed into a transverse bore of a longer knurled handle bar that projects unevenly to one side. One handle tip has a lanyard hole, all exposed ends carry a small chamfer, and there are no tube walls, slots or welds—just two solid rods joined at a single offset T junction.

family_scale1__Z_00446_2.desc: A slim flat tie-bar connector with two staggered parallel rows of small through-holes running its full length. Both ends are rounded with a larger countersunk hole each for fasteners, while an obround central slot provides adjustment; one long edge is a continuous flange-free planar face with a gentle edge break, suited for repeated pinning along its span.

family_scale1__Z_00453_0.desc: Thin flat regular-hexagon sheet-metal plate with uniform thickness and one large central circular bore. Concentric around the bore is an annular band pierced with many small rectangular slots and short radial tabs forming a grille; two equally spaced rings of twelve small round through-holes sit on inner and outer bolt circles bracketing that band, with the slots slightly formed/embossed relative to the plain hexagonal rim.

family_scale1__Z_00467_0.desc: A thin-walled closed-loop bezel of uniform thickness forming one large rounded-rectangular window; the outer contour is decorative, with broadly filleted lower corners, a large-radius bulged ear on one side, and a row of small scallops along the top edge, while the inner edge offsets inward with matching rounds. The rim carries fine transverse ribbing around its exposed face, and there are no through holes or bosses. Frame is a single continuous hollow profile rather than assembled pieces.

family_scale1__Z_00470_1.desc: A compact rectangular plastic vent cover built as a single injection-molded frame, but with the openings arranged as several vertical slot columns rather than one horizontal louver field. It swaps the through mounting holes for rear snap-fit clips and corner screw bosses, adds a perimeter sealing groove on the back, and uses integrally hinged dust flaps over the two central slot columns.

family_scale1__Z_00470_2.desc: A formed sheet-metal louver panel of the same vent family, made from one bent blank with pressed-in angled louvers in two staggered rows and hemmed long edges for stiffness. Instead of molded bosses it has folded side flanges carrying obround adjustment slots, a small punched emblem recess on one end, and a folded return lip that closes the otherwise open back.

family_scale1__Z_00473_2.desc: An elongated narrow perforated strip with a dense central field of small through-holes flanked by two rows of larger holes, plus a keyhole slot near each end for hanging. The two long edges are turned up as short formed lips for stiffness, and a few small circular boss pads are raised on the underside between hole rows.

family_scale1__Z_00474_1.desc: Single-sided C-frame machined from one billet: a vertical backplate carries two horizontal cantilever jaws that project to the same side and end in aligned through-bores for a pin or shaft. The backplate is relieved with rectangular lightening pockets, stiffened by a perimeter rib, and drilled with a six-hole rectangular tapped pattern plus one long adjustment slot; outer corners are rounded and the jaw roots blend into generous gussets.

family_scale1__Z_00480_2.part_family: thin circular perforated screen disc with radial stiffening ribs
family_scale1__Z_00480_2.desc: An oval perforated cover formed as a shallow stamped shell, stiffened by concentric ring ribs plus two longitudinal bars over the mesh. A flanged rim around the outside carries several evenly spaced mounting slots and an embossed central pad.

family_scale1__Z_00487_2.desc: A C-channel variant in which the fin comb sits inside a shallow U-shaped trough formed by two vertical walls on a wide flat base; the fins are fewer and spaced wider apart, the channel ends are closed by small end tabs, and blind bosses protrude from the underside for standoff mounting.

family_scale1__Z_00493_0.desc: One-piece thin-wall rectangular tray with an open top and a continuous perimeter rim. The interior is split by a crisscross of narrow vertical ribs into a regular row-and-column array of identical deep square pockets; every pocket is drafted toward a closed common floor, with rounded mouth corners and fillets at the rib intersections and rim.

family_scale1__Z_00493_1.desc: Low-profile wide organizer tray of the same one-piece thin-wall build, but with a mixed layout: many small square wells across the center flanked by two long rectangular end bins. Ribs are shallow, the wells have softer draft and rounded corners, several wells carry small through drain/vent holes, and the edge is finished with a rolled stiffening rim.

family_scale1__Z_00505_0.desc: Thin flat rectangular plate whose face is densely patterned with a staggered hexagonal-cell honeycomb of circular through-holes, the residual material forming continuous hexagonal webs between the bores. Additional through-holes are grouped in small equally spaced bolt-circle clusters near the edges, together with a few tiny pilot holes and small chamfered edge features.

family_scale1__Z_00505_1.desc: Thicker machined metal panel carrying a smaller hexagonal array of pocketed cells with central through-bores, framed by a wide solid rim drilled with a single row of counterbored clearance holes. Shallow rectangular weight-relief pockets lie between the cell field and the rim, and the outer corners are broadly radiused.

family_scale1__Z_00505_2.desc: Injection-molded plastic grille plate formed as an open honeycomb lattice of thin ribs without bored holes, enclosed by a low perimeter wall. Integral snap-fit clips run along one long edge, two raised locating bosses stand on the opposite edge, and the short ends extend into slotted mounting wings.

family_scale1__Z_00542_0.part_family: flat stamped toothed spring retainer ring
family_scale1__Z_00542_0.desc: A thin, flat annular spring plate with a round central through-hole and an inward-pointing three-finger triangular spring/pawl set clustered around the bore. The outer edge carries a regular ring of small rectangular radial teeth/lugs, with one necked datum tab at the top, a shallow coined band around the rim, and short raised ribs between the teeth.

family_scale1__Z_00542_1.part_family: flat stamped toothed spring retainer ring
family_scale1__Z_00542_1.desc: A slightly dished lock washer of the same family, but with an internally splined bore of many fine teeth instead of fingers. It has six broad external ears, each pierced with a round mounting hole, plus two opposed ID locating notches, a rolled outer edge, and a light cone formed into the web.

family_scale1__Z_00542_2.part_family: flat stamped toothed spring retainer ring
family_scale1__Z_00542_2.desc: An open C-shaped stamped retainer ring with a single gap in the annulus rather than a closed circle. Alternating long and short outer tangs include several bent axially into hooks, the ID has one keyway slot and an elongated radial adjustment slot, and three embossed dimples stiffen the web between the gap ends.

family_scale1__Z_00551_0.part_family: one-piece perforated strap fastener with hexagonal locking head
family_scale1__Z_00551_0.desc: A slender flat strap of constant thin rectangular section runs from a chamfered free tip to an enlarged end head, joined monolithically with a short stepped neck. The strap carries one long centered row of identical rectangular through-slots (a ladder pattern) over most of its length, leaving a solid lead-in at the tip and a solid landing at the head. The head is a compact six-flat block whose end face holds a centered blind socket with a threefold internal web pattern meeting on the axis; the strap-to-head junction uses small fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00551_1.part_family: one-piece perforated strap fastener with hexagonal locking head
family_scale1__Z_00551_1.desc: Similar one-piece tie, but with a low oval locking capsule instead of a hex block: the capsule is a smooth shell with a side-entry strap mouth, an internal spring pawl boss, and a molded thumb tab on top. Its strap is wider and carries two staggered rows of oblong piercing slots, with shallow transverse grip ribs molded on one face between the rows and a tapered rounded lead-in. Fillets are generous at the capsule and a single anti-twist rib runs along the strap centerline.

family_scale1__Z_00551_2.part_family: one-piece perforated strap fastener with hexagonal locking head
family_scale1__Z_00551_2.desc: Heavier ratchet variant of the family: a flat strap with continuous angled ratchet teeth along one edge rather than through windows, ending at a compact rectangular pawl housing that has a through strap channel, a separate leaf-spring insert pocket, and a small release lever boss. The free end is narrowed to a pointed lead-in, the tooth roots are radiused, and the junction to the housing is reinforced by a pair of longitudinal ribs and a filleted shoulder.

family_scale1__Z_00559_1.part_family: radial spider hub with end mounting lugs
family_scale1__Z_00559_1.desc: A four-arm cross variant of the same hub family: a round central boss with a keyed bore throws off four tapered arms at right angles. Adjacent arms are tied by triangular gusset ribs, and each arm finishes in an open fork lug with two small cross-holes instead of a closed pad, giving a lighter, more skeletal bracket.

family_scale1__Z_00573_0.desc: A flat rectangular base panel carries a low outer rim and an irregular network of thin upstanding walls that split the top face into several shallow uniform-depth pockets of differing size. One corner is molded as a dense rectangular grille of small square through-openings, two small raised pedestals sit inside an interior bay, and the thin walls join the base and each other with small root fillets over an essentially flat underside.

family_scale1__Z_00573_1.desc: A differently laid-out enclosure half of the same family uses a single deep central well bordered by stepped shelves, with a continuous snap groove around the perimeter and a row of slotted mounting bosses along one side. Stiffening ribs run diagonally across the underside, and ventilation is provided by a long louvered slot strip rather than a square grille block.

family_scale1__Z_00590_0.desc: Thin flat sheet-metal plate with a central circular hub and three identical arms radiating equally from the center. The hub has a round center bore with an internal across-flats/hex feature and an embossed concentric bead pattern; each arm ends in a round ear whose through hole is reinforced by a formed annular eyelet, and all three eyelets sit on one common bolt circle. Small pointed triangular tabs project beside each outer ear, and the whole part keeps a uniform thin wall with pressed stiffening ribs around the holes.

family_scale1__Z_00590_2.desc: Two-arm curved sheet-metal hub yoke: an S-shaped thin plate with a raised central boss carrying a tapped bore, two swept arms ending in large formed eyelets, a small countersunk mounting hole near the hub, and pressed stiffening beads along each arm with the outer edges turned up as a shallow flange.

family_scale1__Z_00594_1.part_family: slender serrated precision bar (miniature rack / knurled flat linkage)
family_scale1__Z_00594_1.desc: A straight flat strip of the same serrated-bar family, but textured with a criss-cross diamond knurl pressed into both broad faces rather than toothed edges. It has three evenly spaced transverse pin holes along its length, square-cut ends with small edge chamfers, and one shallow longitudinal relief groove down a broad face.

family_scale1__Z_00595_2.part_family: stepped slotted-panel file and card rack
family_scale1__Z_00595_2.desc: A wider banking variant with four equal-height slotted dividers spaced evenly along one continuous base rail to form multiple vertical file slots. The base is a closed rectangle with a single diagonal brace in each end bay rather than full X bracing, divider tops are cut in a gentle sawtooth step, and a small finger-pull opening is pierced near the top of each divider.

family_scale1__Z_00601_1.part_family: thin flat UAV multi-rotor frame hub plate
family_scale1__Z_00601_1.desc: A single thin plate makes a hexacopter hub: a round center with one six-hole through bolt circle and a large central lightening cutout, from which six identical straight arms radiate evenly. Every arm is stiffened by two pressed longitudinal ribs, has a pair of elongated cable-tie slots, and ends in a flat motor ear drilled with a three-hole triangular pattern; thickness stays constant with no raised standoffs and only small root fillets.

family_scale1__Z_00604_1.desc: A similar prismatic drilled block but with the hole field in a symmetric square grid on two opposite faces only, using blind tapped bores rather than through-holes. It has one central rectangular through-window without steps, a shallow counterbored recess around it, and an integral peripheral flange with corner mounting bores.

family_scale1__Z_00610_1.desc: A different guarding frame in the same family is a single-face square-tube rectangle with welded corner gussets, dense vertical balusters across the full width, and two mid-height crossrails. One stile carries hinge tabs and the opposite stile carries a latch boss, while flanged side plates use a mixed pattern of round holes and slotted holes.

family_scale1__Z_00610_2.desc: Another variant is a shallow equipment bezel: a rounded-corner rectangular extrusion frame leaves a wide central clear opening, with perforated side columns and removable crossbars located by keyhole slots. Pressed threaded bosses and a continuous rear mounting flange replace the matched rear tube outline and end mullion bays.

family_scale1__Z_00611_1.part_family: machined perforated interface plate on downturned side rails
family_scale1__Z_00611_1.desc: A wider, thinner perforated deck uses only a regular square array of threaded holes with no bolt-circle groups, replacing the window with a raised central circular boss interrupted by a cross slot. Downturned rails run on all four edges to make a shallow open-bottom tray, the rails carry row of oblong lightening pockets and large internal corner fillets, and one short rail includes two keyhole slots for hanging.

family_scale1__Z_00618_2.desc: Another same-family variant is a compact slotted guide bar with a single dovetail groove along one face, grouped transverse vent slots in the middle, counterbored mounting holes in an asymmetric three-hole layout near both ends, and larger corner rounds; it omits the central through hole and the dense end scallops.

family_scale1__Z_00619_0.part_family: thin perimeter-toothed flat linkage plate (castellated gear-plate link)
family_scale1__Z_00619_0.desc: A flat plate of uniform thickness with an elongated waisted body whose entire outer edge is castellated into a regular row of rectangular teeth. Two equal circular through-holes sit on the longitudinal centreline toward the ends, joined by a central web pierced by two rectangular windows and a pair of small oblong slots, with all faces left as sharp cut edges and no raised bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00619_2.part_family: thin perimeter-toothed flat linkage plate (castellated gear-plate link)
family_scale1__Z_00619_2.desc: A curved D-shaped toothed cam plate from the same thin stock, with a castellated edge following only the round side and a smooth straight spine opposite. It has one large offset pivot bore with a raised boss ring, a single sweeping arcuate follower slot, and two small fixing holes drilled near the spine.

family_scale1__Z_00633_1.desc: A straight tubular hub carries two equal-diameter external spur-gear rings, one at each end, separated by six axial stiffening ribs. The through bore is internally splined for a shaft, and two diametrically opposed radial pin holes pass through the barrel between the gear rings.

family_scale1__Z_00634_0.part_family: slender fluted/profiled micro-shaft pin with axial through-bore
family_scale1__Z_00634_0.desc: A solid metal pin far longer than it is wide, with a constant four-lobe cruciform cross-section along its whole length. Four rounded outer lobes are separated by radiused re-entrant roots, the exposed lobe edges are broken with small chamfers, and a small axial hole passes straight through from end to end.

family_scale1__Z_00636_0.desc: One constant-thickness flat blank defined only by a smooth outer contour: an extended right arm ending in a round pad, two raised scallops along the top, a large rounded left lobe, and two downward rounded tangs separated by an underside notch. The cut edges are square to the faces with tangent fillets at transitions; there are no through holes, bends, ribs, or bosses.

family_scale1__Z_00636_2.desc: A compact lever-style blank with an off-center circular hub, one hub bore with a keyway notch, a short arm ending in a closed eye, and two curved counterweight lobes opposite the arm. The part remains one uniform-thickness plate with smooth tangent outer fillets and a pattern of lightening cutouts around the hub.

family_scale1__Z_00644_1.part_family: flat toothed reluctor/timing wheel with cross-spoke web
family_scale1__Z_00644_1.desc: Same-family stamped sensor ring with one-piece annular rim and six radial spokes meeting a raised central flange; instead of a through bore, the flange carries three equally spaced mounting holes on a pitch circle and a single keyway. The outside edge uses punched rectangular gaps rather than projecting teeth, with one widened index gap and small chamfers on all tooth flanks.

family_scale1__Z_00656_0.desc: Open-topped rectangular thin-walled shroud whose four side walls are joined into a continuous loop with a closed inner cavity; each wall is pierced by a regular row of tall narrow vertical through-slots separated by thin ribs, with twelve slots on the long faces and ten on the short faces, framed by small top and bottom edge lips and four low corner feet.

family_scale1__Z_00656_1.desc: Low-profile rectangular vent bezel: a flat grille plate rather than a deep box, carrying several staggered banks of short horizontal slots across its face, a solid perimeter flange with countersunk mounting holes at the corners, and integral snap hooks on the rear edge for clipping into a panel cutout.

family_scale1__Z_00657_1.part_family: thin square radial-rib grille guard panel
family_scale1__Z_00657_1.desc: Rectangular guard panel of the same family with a larger central hub ring and both diagonal and orthogonal spokes, forming eight open sectors bounded by two concentric rectangular rails. A smaller set of fine perforations sits only along the outer rail, four corner mounting lugs have countersunk holes, and the hub is counterbored on one face rather than through.

family_scale1__Z_00665_0.desc: A single flat plate of uniform thickness with threefold symmetry: three rounded lobes are spaced evenly around a central hub and merged into one solid body by curved webs. The entire outer rim carries a fine gear-tooth serration, and the plate has four circular through-bores, one at the center and one in each lobe with the outer three equally spaced on a common bolt circle, plus small angled chamfers at the waists between lobes.

family_scale1__Z_00665_2.desc: A thicker carousel-style plate with six short lobes around the middle and a coarse castellated tooth pattern on the outside edge. A single central splined bore is ringed by six holes on a bolt circle that mix features, alternating plain through-holes with counterbored tapped holes, and shallow recessed pads are raised around each hole on one face.

family_scale1__Z_00667_0.part_family: double-flanged internal ring gear (internally toothed annulus)
family_scale1__Z_00667_0.desc: Smooth cylindrical outer shell formed as a constant-width annular web, closed at both axial ends by integral side flanges whose outer edges stand slightly proud of the toothed band; the through-bore carries straight internal gear teeth continuously around the full circumference between the flanges, with the bore stepped so the spline minor diameter differs slightly from the flange counterbores, and the tooth roots read as repeated circumferential lines across the band in side view.

family_scale1__Z_00667_1.part_family: double-flanged internal ring gear (internally toothed annulus)
family_scale1__Z_00667_1.desc: Single-flange internal ring gear: a plain outer barrel with one radial end flange drilled with an even bolt circle of through holes and a pilot recess, the opposite end open; the bore carries helical internal teeth running the full length with a chamfered lead-in at the open end and an internal retaining-ring groove cut close to the flange face.

family_scale1__Z_00682_0.desc: A single-piece sprung tweezer formed from two long, thin flat arms held parallel and tied together at one end by a closed rectangular bridge that acts as the spring hinge. The free ends are mating jaws edged with a fine interlocking row of small semicircular teeth, with a uniform thin wall, slightly tapered plan, small root fillets, and shallow internal guide ribs on the gripping head.

family_scale1__Z_00686_0.part_family: internally toothed cylindrical ring / internal gear coupling sleeve with axial mounting holes
family_scale1__Z_00686_0.desc: A short, thick-walled cylindrical ring machined as an internal spur gear/spline: a smooth round outer shell encloses a bore lined with a full circle of straight axial teeth that run most of the length and stop short of the end faces, leaving narrow plain bands. Four through-holes parallel to the axis are equally spaced on a bolt circle in the rim between the tooth roots and the outside; tooth edges carry small uniform edge breaks and the end faces are flat and plain.

family_scale1__Z_00698_1.desc: A longer extruded aluminum guide rail with a symmetric dovetail cross-section and V-shaped raceway grooves ground on two opposite faces. Two axial through-bores run end to end, while counterbored mounting holes are cross-drilled at regular intervals and each end face is tapped. All long edges carry small chamfers and the groove roots are filleted.

family_scale1__Z_00701_0.desc: A solid constant-width cylindrical spur gear with external involute teeth around the full rim and a smooth coaxial through bore. The flat end faces have no hub, keyway, or lightening features; the repeating tooth flanks meet small filleted roots.

family_scale1__Z_00707_1.desc: A straight cylindrical rubber bellows has a smooth sealing cuff at each end and a dozen deeper convolutions between them. One cuff is integrated with a square mounting flange carrying four through holes and a reinforcing gusset, while the opposite cuff adds an external clamp groove and two tiny vent holes.

family_scale1__Z_00707_2.desc: A stepped convoluted plastic boot uses three straight bore sections joined by short tapered transitions, with fine ribs only on the middle section. The largest cuff contains one oval cable slot and an internal sealing lip, the smallest cuff has an axial keyway and a snap-ring groove, and several external flats orient the part in a clamp.

family_scale1__Z_00711_1.part_family: arched leaf strip with drilled end lug
family_scale1__Z_00711_1.desc: An arched leaf strip of the same family but with a mounting ear at both ends instead of only one. Each ear is pierced by a single elongated slot rather than a clustered bolt circle, and the band narrows gradually from midspan toward the ears. A shallow pressed bead runs lengthwise along the curve to stiffen the otherwise uniform-thickness strip.

family_scale1__Z_00713_1.desc: A same-family badge tag as a rounded rectangular plate with one offset oval hanging lug and a single through hole. A continuous rim encloses a blank recessed name panel beside a cluster of raised circular pads, with two parallel internal slots, generous corner fillets and no eyelet boss beyond the lug.

family_scale1__Z_00714_2.desc: A short flattened-oval header tube with crimped sealed ends and a rolled seam along one edge. Its broad faces carry a grouped grid of punched ports rather than one continuous row, plus a central saddle notch and small end flanges for mounting; formed as a pressed shell of even thickness.

family_scale1__Z_00727_1.part_family: thin framed honeycomb ventilation grille panel
family_scale1__Z_00727_1.desc: A compact square version of the same vent family: a thicker flat perimeter flange with counterbored mounting holes near the corners, surrounding a single centered field of pressed hexagonal through-holes with a wide solid margin. It is a single formed sheet rather than a ribbed sandwich, with several raised standoff bosses on the back for board spacing and no end latch.

family_scale1__Z_00741_1.desc: Same-family flat spring laid out as a single smooth U-bend instead of an S-curve: a wider slotted tongue with oblong lightening holes along the spine, one straight mounting ear pierced by two round holes, and a rounded hooked catch at the free tip. Uniform sheet thickness with generous bend radii and a shallow coined stiffening bead beside the openings.

family_scale1__Z_00749_2.desc: Flat ring-style plate made from a central annular boss joined to the rim by four symmetric C-shaped spokes, leaving large open windows between them. Each spoke splits into a small clevis-like double ear with a cross-drilled pin hole, while through holes are patterned on a single bolt circle around the bore; deep scalloped reliefs between the spokes lighten the part yet keep a uniform wall thickness throughout.

family_scale1__Z_00758_2.desc: Narrow asymmetric profile with one tall conduit channel beside three small snap-fit lanes and an angled reflector wall. A perforated mounting flange and evenly spaced transverse slots take brackets, internal ribs stiffen the thin walls, and one closed end carries a molded cable knockout.

family_scale1__Z_00762_1.desc: Flat steel tie-bar of constant thin gage with a straight rectangular tongue at one end pierced by two equal clevis-pin holes and a forked slotted opposite end closed by a single cross-hole; small round lightening holes are spaced along the straight web and all outer corners are broken with small radii.

family_scale1__Z_00764_0.desc: A slender solid blade whose thick rounded root cap has an obround, capsule-like cross-section formed by two semicircular edge radii, then blends through a small fillet into a long straight web that narrows in planform to a sharp point at the far tip.
