One face carries a shallow recessed pocket near the root while the opposite face is essentially flat; there are no holes, slots, or bosses, only drafted side walls and a rounded tip transition at the thick end.

family_scale1__Z_00765_0.desc: A thin-gauge sheet formed by press bending into an open-backed hood with a closed top, bottom and two side cheeks; the narrow front wall carries a four-by-five array of oblong slots with small corner radii, framed by folded stiffening hems, while the deep side cheek is profiled with a flowing cutout ending in a semicircular finger notch, and plain return flanges line the rear for fastening.

family_scale1__Z_00765_1.desc: A shallow three-sided U-channel cover that slides over an electronic module, swapping the slotted face for a broad top plate with two staggered rows of short vent louvers and one side cheek opened by a single large D-shaped connector cutout; the open back has a pierced flange of round mounting holes, the opposite cheek is plain, and all exposed edges are hemmed for stiffness and safe handling.

family_scale1__Z_00779_1.desc: A taller cylindrical sunflower heat sink with a longer body, a smaller count of thicker radial fins, and a continuous outer shroud ring tying all fin tips together for protection. One end carries a flat mounting face with a pattern of tapped holes around the central bore, while the bore itself is counterbored to seat an LED module.

family_scale1__Z_00793_0.desc: This part is a compact block of several rounded-rectangular bars bent through repeated uniform-radius right-angle and U-bends so the runs weave over and under one another across three stacked height levels, nested only by contact rather than welded joints; all long bar edges carry a small consistent edge fillet, bend intrados share one generous radius, the cut ends are left plain, and there are no holes, slots, ribs, bosses or shell walls—geometry is purely swept/bent bar.

family_scale1__Z_00793_1.desc: A single continuous flat conductor folded in one plane into a serpentine meander of equal U-turns, with both tails kicked out to a perpendicular plane as mounting tabs; each tab carries punched holes, the terminal transitions use enlarged bend radii, and small edge rounds are applied only along the outer faces while the meander root fillets stay tight.

family_scale1__Z_00805_0.desc: A thin flat spur gear with continuous external teeth on a circular rim, a central through bore in an inner hub, and three radial spokes tying the hub to the rim. Three large sector-shaped openings between the spokes cut through the web for lightening, with generous fillets at the spoke roots and a small auxiliary through feature on the web near the bore.

family_scale1__Z_00805_1.desc: A compact spur gear with a solid web instead of open spokes, a one-sided protruding hub boss, and a keyed central bore for shaft drive. Four evenly spaced circular lightening holes pierce the web on a bolt circle, and the tooth roots are fully filleted with a small chamfer on the bore entry.

family_scale1__Z_00806_2.part_family: stamped and formed spring contact terminal
family_scale1__Z_00806_2.desc: A panel-edge grounding clip folded as a closed shallow channel with two side walls joined by a back web. The upper wall is slit into three short independent spring tines separated by narrow slots, each tine carrying an inward-lanced barb, while one side wall has an extruded pierced boss for a screw and an outward foot with an oblong mounting slot; the back web is patterned with a row of small round holes and an embossed alignment groove, and the whole part is made with simple right-angle folds so it clips over a flange.

family_scale1__Z_00819_1.part_family: waffle-ribbed molded plastic cover grille panel
family_scale1__Z_00819_1.desc: Wider cover of the same molded-panel family using a denser blind-pocket grid interrupted by a large central rectangular window cut clear through the shell. Fastening is by countersunk holes in the four corners plus snap clips molded along the rim, with a shallow gasket groove just inside the rim and generous fillets on every pocket corner.

family_scale1__Z_00819_2.part_family: waffle-ribbed molded plastic cover grille panel
family_scale1__Z_00819_2.desc: Narrow open vent grille in the same family where the blind waffle is replaced by through slots between straight longitudinal ribs so air can pass, all framed by a flat mounting flange. A recessed pull handle is molded at one end, triangular stiffening webs tie the ribs to the flange on the back, and two slotted holes allow positional adjustment during mounting.
